notes.title: Update 1.4.0
notes.content: [h3]Mejoras[/h3][list][*][p]Added compatibility with SteamDeck (Verified).[/p][/*][*][p]Added a short introduction for new players or those who reset their progress.[/p][/*][*][p]Custom keybinding for keyboard now available from the menu.[/p][/*][*][p]New graphics options added:[/p][list][*][p]Depth of Field:[/p][p][i]Enables or disables blur on your own body or nearby objects.[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Motion Blur:[/p][p][i]Enables or disables camera motion smoothing and blur when turning.[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]General gameplay improvements.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved code input system on numeric panels.[/p][/*][*][p]Preparations for upcoming DLC [i]"[/i][url="https://store.steampowered.com/dlc/2904740/"]Day at the Office - Signed[/url][i]"[/i]:[/p][list][*][p]Added planar reflection system compatible with older systems.[/p][/*][*][p]New melee weapon added.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]New special door-closing system implemented for certain cinematic moments.[/p][/*][*][p]Translation fixes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed certain crouch animations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some controller input actions.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved UI issues at certain screen resolutions.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.3
notes.content:
[h3][b]Fixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a door that was left open unintentionally.
[*] Added Spanish translations.
[*] It is now possible to adjust the brightness from the controller correctly.
[*] Xbox controllers could sometimes cause errors in the menus.
[*] Fixed a bug in a scene if you were crouching.
[/list]

[h3][b]Improvements[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a sound in the gun room to guide the player to one of the secrets.
[*] The corpse pieces that can rain down now bleed.
[*] Added animation to the death caused by the nuns in the chess room.
[*] Modified message that could cause confusion in one of the puzzles
[*] Modified tutorials that could appear at confusing moments for the player.
[*] Improved the tutorial, including more tips. (They can be disabled in options)
[*] Added visual reinforcement in the gas puzzle for people with color blindness.
[*] Reordered the interface for branching conversations. More compact.
[*] Modified audio after completing puzzle in the Clock Room. Added subtitles.
[*] Full controller support. Improved controller type detection and player usage regarding Controller or Keyboard/Mouse
[*] Added vibration and use of haptic triggers (PS5).
[*] Added new scenes and horror elements.
[*] Reduced head movement when breathing.
[*] Smoothed out the right Axis of the controller to improve accuracy.
[/list]

notes.title: V1.2 Bug Fixes / Improvements
notes.content:
Fixes
- Fixed being able to move or grab hidden objects
- Jumping now has limited camera rotation in mid-air.
- Fixed an enemy appearing in T-Pose
- Fixed an issue using XInput controllers during branching conversations. (preparing for future full controller support)
- Fixed UI issue. Sometimes reopening a menu after manually changing the controller glyphs would not update correctly.
- Fixed unusual behavior in the clock puzzle.
- Three rooms (black hallway, rooftop, and true ending) were not counting correctly towards the achievement in some cases. All achievements can now be earned.
- Translation fixes.
- Birthday song could not be adjusted from audio options.

Improvements
- Keyboard/mouse can now be used despite having a controller connected.
- Enemies will no longer try to kill you after you are dead.
- Menu will automatically close when attacked.
- Added a cable to the phone (visual improvement)
- New bar to adjust brightness in video options.
- Game trailer replaced

notes.title: V1.1.2 Changes / Bugfixes
notes.content:
[b][h3]Changes[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Now the character has more light. (This will have further improvements in future versions)
[*] Now the hints will stop after the puzle is done.
[/list]

[b][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] The house woman was not killing the character, breaking the game flow. Now you will die after the screamer as intended.
[*] Two doors could be opened under strange circumstances. Now work as intended.
[*] Fixed the mannequin corridor, that had a phone conversation not working as intended.
[/list]

[b][h3]Improvements[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] A few voice acting improvements (sound timings)
[*] A voice line missing.
[/list]

notes.title: V1.1 Bugfixes
